Roster Pipelines

Two pipelines · one SQL table

{{tagline}}

Upload a JSON list of employees, or fill the form derived from the Employee structure. One pipeline stores the rows. The other counts the list.

How Spine hosts this

The page is the frontend. The pipelines are the backend.

01 · JSON

Validate the roster

Employee is a typed Spine structure: id, name, and number. Upload JSON or fill the form generated from that structure. The input step parses the file into a list of rows.

02 · SQL

Store with FROM INPUT

Save roster runs REPLACE INTO employee FROM INPUT. Each JSON object becomes a row in app_sql_rows, scoped to this site, so everyone sees the same table.

03 · Count

Count the JSON list

Count employees runs SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INPUT on the same list and returns a count. It is SQL, not custom code, so it still runs on the public page.
